title: Luotain2 Gate IV-002 process-excitation sensitivity

design.method: blind IV+corrected-risk with declared local-stencil challenger
design.changes_between_conditions: process-noise amplitude only; sensor noise relative ratio stays fixed to simulated state STD

interpretation: Excitation appears to improve identifiability of spatially shifted terms relative to delayed-copy approximations in two restricted synthetic field generators
caveats: The process noise ratio changes latent state distribution and effective absolute sensor noise, though the relative sensor-noise ratio stays 1%
This does not prove causality of increased excitation independent of all other changes; fix absolute sensor variance and measure excitation spectrum in follow-up
New seeds but same synthetic model family, no real sensor validation
Only two world families, three seeds each, and known candidate grammar
No new mathematical theorem, and no claim to WAIVES SDE consistency or full nonlinear discovery
Local stencil challenger gives prior structural advantage for diagonal diffusion
